# UMC capital-claims deliverables

- capital-claims-facts-v1.json: dated numerical facts, primary-source URLs, associate holdings, circular ownership, and subsequent financing.
- funding-inputs-v1.json: June claims, debt maturity schedule, liquidity buckets and treatment constraints.
- capital-claims-narrative-v1.md: original analytical narrative with public primary-source links.
- provenance-qa-v1.json: integrity tests, unresolved items, publication constraints.

All original source documents, parsed source text, web retrieval captures, and source manifests in private-sources/ are research-only and must be excluded from public artifacts. No canonical company registry, site or publication has been modified. Source text is not a public deliverable. Publicly usable deliverables should use original analysis, numerical facts and direct source links.
